message:
As I was sifting through some old family photos, I stumbled upon a picture of my grandchildren playing a board game, completely absorbed in their own little world. It reminded me how important it is to be prepared, not just for emergencies, but for the everyday moments that can bring us together. 

I recently came across some great resources about financial preparedness, which made me think about how planning ahead can free us up to enjoy those simple pleasures. When we take the time to prepare, we create space for more laughter and connection in our lives. 

What are some of your favorite low-tech activities to enjoy with family?
